zh: 全局设置全面适配暗色主题：覆盖设置弹窗内全部 18 个功能菜单、侧栏导航、卡片与媒体账号管理面板，确保深浅主题视觉一致。
修复跨午夜对话排序异常：统一 SQLite 时间戳与 ISO 8601 时区解析逻辑，确保新的一天内创建的对话按时间准确排序在最前。
优化静态页面快照与发布机制：支持部门奖惩与大屏多页面快照持久化，完善大小策略控制与自动化发布同步流程。
en: Complete dark theme adaptation for Global Settings: fully styled all 18 preference tabs, navigation sidebar, cards, and media/account dialogs.
Fixed conversation sorting across midnight boundaries: unified SQLite UTC timestamp parsing with ISO dates to guarantee chronologically accurate ordering.
Enhanced static page snapshot and publishing service: added multi-page snapshot persistence, size policy enforcement, and synchronized demo builds.
